product: Xero connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Xero connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
what_it_does: The managed Xero connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Workspace admins can enable it from the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest accounting data such as invoices, payments, and contacts from Xero into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The managed Xero connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Workspace admins can enable it from the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The managed Xero connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
